title: ID0394109-DC/Si-D/FR -[07FhaL] SCB offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
No SCB connection.
• On-site intervention required:
• Provide a router in case the connectivity problem is due
to the Teltonika.
• Provide a SIM card in case the card is defective.
Provide a Linux key and a CFast card in case the problem
comes from the configuration
Look to change operator, there are many disconnections
Root cause:
Solution:
Charger online on SCB
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:  NO
Warranty Status: YES
